ruling: R49 (Drew, 2026-09-15): `Encased X` is the same rung as `Pristine X`.
reportOnlyUntil: REPORT ONLY until a steward dispatches it. The lane writes only under BACKFILL_APPLY=true.
finding: 1,323 pool rows in baseball/topps-pristine name an `Encased X` rung. The source spells the same rungs `Pristine X`, and the catalog holds those spellings checklist-backed.
whyNotAVocabularyEntry: #2174's checklistSpellingAdoption.ts adopts only a STRICT EXTENSION of the stated text ("Silver" -> "Silver Prizms"); its own contract states the stated colour must survive into the answer. `Encased Aqua Refractor` -> `Pristine Aqua Refractor` SUBSTITUTES the leading word, so that mechanism cannot carry it, and adding it there would violate the module's invariant. The adoption code also reads only `parallel.name` and never the `spellings` array. Hence a committed list, where every row is reviewable in the diff.
rulings: EVERY MAPPING IS 1:1 AND UNAMBIGUOUS, checked against the catalog's own rungs: all 9 distinct `Encased X` rungs seen in the pool have exactly ONE `Pristine X` counterpart. A rung with no counterpart is left alone and counted, never guessed.

EVERY ENTRY IS A REPOINT, NEVER A RELOCATE. The parallel is not part of sold_comps' partition key (/cardId), so no row changes partition; only hobbyiqCardId is patched and the #1941 address guard still runs.
THE DESTINATION SPELLING IS THE CATALOG'S OWN. `toParallelAsPrinted` on each entry carries the checklist's spelling of the rung the row moves to, so a reviewer can see the real name beside the slug.

THE SCALED ESTIMATE WAS WRONG AND THE DIRECT READ WINS. The 2026-09-15 parallel-gap report put this cell at 21,604 rows from census-sample scaling; a direct read finds 1,323, all in 2025. Sample scaling over-counted this cell about 16x, and the committed list carries only rows that were actually read.

census.note: read from prod read-only on 2026-09-15, paged by slug prefix; no cross-partition COUNT over sold_comps.
